original_sql:
SELECT t.txn_id, a.owner_name, t.amount
FROM transactions t, accounts a
WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
  AND t.txn_date >= TO_DATE('2026-02-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND t.status = 'PENDING'
gold_tuned_sql:
SELECT /*+ INDEX(t idx_txn_date) */ t.txn_id, a.owner_name, t.amount
FROM transactions t, accounts a
WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
  AND t.txn_date >= :b1
  AND t.status = :b2
